games.name: Iron Man: Playground
games.desc:
Step into the suit of Ironman in this thrilling Roblox game! Fly through the skies, unleash powerful energy blasts, and take on intense battles with thugs or players. Experience the excitement of being a superhero. Whether you're battling enemies or exploring new locations, the Ironman experience brings all the action to life in an immersive Roblox world!

CONTROLS:
- G: Call Suit / Change Weapon
- E: Repulser
- Q: Secondary Weapon
- F: Hover
- Left Shift: Flight Accelerate / Sprint
- N: Eject/Send
- M: Faceplate
- Hold M: Helmet
- K: Sentry mode (ejected)
- X: Destroy Suit
- V: Flares
- B: Supersonic Flight 
- W/S: Speed up or speed down in flight mode

If you enjoyed the game please leave a like!👍

games.name: [SUMMER] Randomizer: Redux
games.desc:
Game Version: Beta 2.5

This game is an official remake of the OG Randomizer, from the ground up!
It is still under HEAVY development, so everything is subject to change, and everything you see is incomplete! 

To use the admin panel in private servers, type '/admin' in chat.
For a list of commands, just type 'cmds' into the admin panel, premium users get extra commands!

Controls:
M - Menu (only when spawn protection is active, or you died)
C / CTRL / Button B / Circle - Crouch/Slide (while sprinting)
Shift / Left Stick - Sprint
P - Mouse Lock/Unlock
Left Alt - Camera Lock (Third Person)

games.name: Ecos: La Brea
games.desc:
Step into Ice Age North America, 25,000 years ago. In Ecos: La Brea, explore the prehistoric ecosystem preserved by the iconic La Brea Tar Pits of Los Angeles, California.

Pack together as the cunning Dire Wolf, ambush mighty prey as the Saber-tooth Cat, lock horns as the formidable Ancient Bison, gallop freely as the Western Horse, or terraform the landscape as the Columbian Mammoth. Team up with friends and learn about the diverse habitats & animals of La Brea as you play.
